workingDirectory: Heroes 3 HotA/prefix/drive_c/GOG Games/Heroes of Might and Magic III - Horn of the Abyss
notes: A Windows (x86) game run by an arm64 macOS Wine with FEX inside it, in one process with a 96 MB code pool; FEX's code buffers are capped at 24 MB so that the pool holds them (docs/WINDOWS.md). Build the runtime with tools/build_windows_runtime.sh, then profiles/heroes3-hota/install.py copies your own GOG installation. See profiles/heroes3-hota/README.md.
